title: Cinematic Egg Birth
description: A woman in a flowing red dress emerges from a large cracked egg positioned on a stone pedestal. She sits dramatically beneath a ruined stone archway overgrown with vines and pink roses, as a vintage film projector on the left casts beams of light and film reels toward her.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a beautiful woman in a vibrant red dress emerging from a large cracked metallic egg. She sits on a stone pedestal beneath a broken stone archway covered in ivy and pink roses. A vintage film projector on a pillar to the left shines light and floating film strips toward her. Scattered film reels, picture frames, and white flowers surround the base. Dramatic lighting with lightning visible through the broken arch, dark background, highly detailed digital painting.
